findings.title: Unsynchronized access to active window state
findings.message: The workspace struct (documents map and active field) is read and written without synchronization. activate is called from the native focus callback, while Available/Execute run from menu handlers. If these run on different goroutines this is a data race. The map is also not mutated after setup, but the active field is.
findings.suggestion: Guard active with a sync.Mutex (or atomic.Value) and lock in activate/current.

findings.title: Double Close and incomplete cleanup on error
findings.message: If openDocument fails for B after A was opened successfully, A is not yet in w.documents when the error is returned? Actually A is added, but if B fails, its own cleanup closes B. However, a failure inside the openDocument defer for a partially-opened document only closes the repository; files attached earlier (AttachFiles succeeded but later steps) are not stopped. Also a.Close() is called twice, relying on idempotence.
findings.suggestion: Remove the duplicate a.Close() and ensure d.files.Stop() is called on openDocument error paths after AttachFiles.
